<Clan>NpcGenerator.csv.heading: How many cats

BarteringCost.csv.heading: Bartering

Curious.Drop.heading: What traits do in play
Curious.Drop.text: If the item is tagged Gameplay.Inventory.Consumable, it reads the two Curious.Drop keys and, if one of the player's traits is Curious (5), rolls for +1.
